SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch Registry
REPORT
Date June 25, 1936

Subject Chinese Literary Writers' Society - new body formed.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

A new organization called the Chinese Literary
Writers' Society (中國文藝作家協會) was inaugurated on June
7, 1936, in the Dah Si Yang Restaurant, 710 Foochow Road.
The ostensible object of the Society is to promote mutual
friendship among Chinese writers and to study the literary
science but there is no doubt that the Society will also take
part in the national salvation movement.

The following are the members of the Executive
Committee of the Society :-

Hsia Kai-tseng (夏丐尊), Chief Editor of the Kai
Ming Book Store, Foochow Road.

Yih Sung-dau (章雪陶), an editor of the Kai
Ming Book Store, Foochow Road.

Zung Tseng-toh (鄭振鐸), Principal of the College
of Arts of the Chinan University, Chenju.
His name was appended to a manifesto issued
by local educational circles on December 12,
1935, and opposing the autonomy movement in
North China.

Hung Sung (洪深), a dramatist. He was
arrested by the S.M.P. in 1931 at the
instance of the Chinese authorities on
suspicion of being a communist but the
charge against him was subsequently dismissed.

Wong Tung-chao (王統照), a returned student from
England, and editor of the Vung Yah (文季)
Monthly Magazine.

Sung Chi-yu (沈起予), editor of the Kwang Ming
Half Monthly, office at 131 Route Maresca.

Fu Tung-hwa (傅東華), a textbook writer for the
Commercial Press.

Mou Deng (茅盾), a novelist.

Zi Mur-yung (徐懋庸), a writer. He was a graduate
of the defunct Labour University, Kiangwan.

The Society claims to have at present a membership
of some 100 persons. The membership fee is $2 per **〔此处转录不清〕**
So far the Society has no office, but **〔此处转录不清〕**

S.I，特科档案室
报告
日期：1936年6月25日

事由：中国文艺作家协会——新成立的团体。

呈报人：侦探督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人：[签名]

一个名为“中国文艺作家协会”的新组织于1936年6月7日在福州路710号的大西洋餐厅（Dah Si Yang Restaurant）成立。该协会表面上的宗旨是促进中国作家之间的友谊并研究文学理论，但毫无疑问，该协会也将参与救国运动。

以下是该协会执行委员会的成员：

夏丐尊（Hsia Kai-tseng），福州路开明书店总编辑。

章雪陶（Yih Sung-dau）(音译)，福州路开明书店编辑。

郑振铎（Zung Tseng-toh），真如暨南大学艺术学院院长。他的名字曾附署于1935年12月12日由本地教育界发表的反对华北自治运动的宣言之后。

洪深（Hung Sung），剧作家。他曾于1931年应中国当局要求，因涉嫌为共产党员而被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕，但随后针对他的指控被撤销。

王统照（Wong Tung-chao），留英归国学生，《文季》（Vung Yah）月刊编辑。

沈起予（Sung Chi-yu），《光明》半月刊编辑，办事处位于马思南路131号。

傅东华（Fu Tung-hwa），商务印书馆教科书编写者。

茅盾（Mou Deng），小说家。

徐懋庸（Zi Mur-yung），作家。他是已停办的江湾劳动大学的毕业生。

该协会声称目前拥有约100名会员。会费为每**〔此处转录不清〕**2元
